description: Tray companion for defrag.racing: backs up Quake 3 DeFRaG demos and opens defrag:// links in your engine

script: # The NSIS bundle installs per user (currentUser), so this never raises a
# UAC prompt. It is run rather than unpacked because the installer is what
# registers the defrag:// protocol handler - a portable extraction would
# leave every server link on the website dead.
# Found by display name rather than by registry key, so a change to the
# bundle identifier cannot leave the install orphaned. UninstallString is
# quoted, and Start-Process chokes on the quotes.

notes: The launcher updates itself on launch, so the version Scoop has on record can trail the one actually installed. Running 'scoop update defrag-racing-launcher' anyway is harmless.
On first run, paste a token from your defrag.racing profile: Settings -> Security -> Launcher tokens.
